findings.title: Delayed boot Show overrides a newer widget disable
findings.reproduction: SOURCE PROJECTION, not Windows execution: metrics and widget enabled at boot; use the available ready Metrics checkbox to commit widget disabled during the armed 2500 ms post-ready Show delay; release native menu; allow callback and type two characters. Show restores visible=true and recurring timers despite persisted false. Healthy no-disable and refused-write controls differ as described in report.
findings.root_cause: Boot arms unrestricted WPMWidget_Show once; committed disable/Hide never revokes it, and Show unconditionally sets visible true without checking latest preference/generation.
findings.silent_failure: The stale callback logs successful Show, not refusal; normal exception backstop sees no exception. Menu can retain stale false check; SaveFullConfig later serializes erroneous live true.
findings.regression_test: Genuine isolated AHK startup/tray receiving: commit disable through configured menu before one-shot deadline; assert HWND stays hidden, recurring timers do not re-arm, live/persisted false remain; healthy, refused-write, post-show-disable and duplicate controls.
findings.basis: Windows exact-source deduction, no AHK execution

findings.title: Graph reports success after native bitmap upload refuses
findings.reproduction: SOURCE PROJECTION, not Windows execution: active graph with an accepted prior bitmap; next native UpdateLayeredWindow returns zero with otherwise healthy frame/draw/cleanup. _GRDrawBitmapRun returns false, RenderGraph returns true anyway, Tick shows retained stale/empty surface with no refusal diagnostic. Persistent refusal prevents frame progress; healthy next upload can recover.
findings.root_cause: WPMWidget_RenderGraph discards GR_DrawBitmap Boolean receipt and returns true; PrewarmGraph similarly logs success without consuming the receipt. Lower bitmap facade returns false rather than throwing.
findings.silent_failure: All lower bitmap acquisition/upload/release/debt owners were checked: no logger, notifier or refusal observer on native false paths. No exception reaches the WPM catch/global OnError; GDI+ thrown failure backstops cover different paths.
findings.regression_test: Run actual AHK RenderGraph->GR_DrawBitmap->_GRDrawBitmapRun with faithful native false-upload/allocation/cleanup-debt seams and healthy/throw controls. Assert refusal reaches caller with visible diagnostic and no false presentation acknowledgment, then healthy retry progresses.
findings.basis: Windows exact-source deduction, no AHK execution
